# Landscape metrics

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(terra)
landscape_sempach <- rast("data/landcover_4.tif")
df_levels <- data.frame(id = 1:4, cover = c("settlement", "agriculture", "forest", "unproductive"))
levels(landscape_sempach) <- df_levels
```

## Introduction

Patch/class/landscape
Buffers with multiple sizes
Focal indices

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(dplyr)
library(landscapemetrics)
```
```{r}

landscape <- rast(landscape)
plot(landscape)

check_landscape(landscape)
check_landscape(landscape_sempach)

show_patches(landscape, directions = 4, labels = TRUE)
# default
show_patches(landscape, directions = 8, labels = TRUE)

show_cores(landscape, class = c(1, 2))


# All available metrics
list_lsm()

list_lsm(level = "class", type = "shape metric")

#?lsm_p_area()

# Patch area
res <- lsm_p_area(landscape)
res
res[res$class == 2 & res$value > 0.005, "id"]


# Several metrics at the same time
calculate_lsm(landscape, what = c("lsm_c_pland", "lsm_l_ta", "lsm_l_te"), full_name = TRUE)
calculate_lsm(landscape, type = "aggregation metric", level = c("patch", "landscape"), full_name = TRUE)

metrics <- calculate_lsm(landscape, what = c("lsm_c_cai_mn", "lsm_c_area_mn", "lsm_c_pland", "lsm_c_ed"))
calculate_correlation(metrics) # common to remove stuff with correlation 0.7 or higher
```
